title: MemConflict: Evaluating Long-Term Memory Systems Under Memory Conflicts
provenance: Editorial extraction and Chinese writing controls, not a saved live model answer. Source excerpts are verbatim from the saved full text, physical PDF pages 3, 9-13 and 19.
source_excerpts:
To improve realism and diversity, MemConflict initializes each user from a persona seed 𝑧𝑢
sampled from Persona Hub2. Conditioned on 𝑧𝑢, an LLM generates the structured profile of user 𝑢
according to predefined attribute schemas:

Building on the initialized user profiles, MemConflict constructs long-horizon, cross-session inter-
action histories in which user-related information accumulates, changes, and is revisited across
sessions.

To this end, MemConflict first simulates plausible
user evolution over time and then instantiates dynamic, static, and conditional conflicts within
the resulting timelines.

Given the simulated timeline T𝑢 and the session-level information constructed in Section 3.3,
MemConflict converts each session slot into a natural multi-turn dialogue.
MemConflict uses a two-stage process: synopsis generation followed by dialogue realization.

For each evaluable instance,
MemConflict issues a query immediately after the corresponding session 𝑠𝑡 has been ingested
and uses the history prefix 𝐻𝑡 as the memory available to the system.

MemConflict supports both black-box evaluation of final answers and white-box analysis of memory
retrieval and ranking.

For the same
conflict-targeted queries used in the black-box evaluation, we analyze the top-3 memory items
returned by each system and report SEH@3 and SRS.

solution_walkthrough.text: MemConflict 先用 Persona Hub 中的画像种子生成结构化用户档案，再以这些档案为基础模拟用户随时间的变化，在形成的时间线上设置动态、静态和条件冲突。
随后，系统把模拟时间线和已构造的会话信息写成对话：先生成会话概要，再展开为多轮对话。只有对应冲突已经具备可评估条件、相关会话已被摄入后，才发出查询；此时可用记忆只包含截至该会话的历史，不含未来会话。
同一组冲突查询接入两种评测：黑盒检查最终答案，白盒分析记忆检索与排序。因此，报告答案表现和分析检索环节是两条不同的评测视角。

Solution: 对话生成先产生会话概要，再将概要实现为对话。
Solution: 查询只使用对应可评估会话被摄入后可用的历史前缀。
Solution: 历史构建以初始化后的用户档案为基础。
Solution: 先模拟用户演变，再在形成的时间线上设置冲突。
Solution: 对话生成使用模拟时间线和构建好的会话信息。
Solution: 对应可评估会话被摄入后，才发出查询。
Solution: 基准用黑盒评估最终答案，用白盒分析记忆检索与排序。
Solution: 黑盒评估和白盒记忆分析使用同一组冲突查询。
